# Add action button

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Add, New and Create buttons are kit Buttons carrying the Plus icon.

Scaffold: `php artisan standards:make page --flavor=index <Name>`.

Kit: @kit/ui Button.

- `ActionBar` from `@kit/ui` for the action bar: Where page-level actions sit (props: actions descriptors).
